fields.label: Lot
fields.description: Registered tea lot from which the sample was taken for testing.

fields.label: Testing Date
fields.description: Date on which the tea sample was tested.

fields.label: Incoming Grade
fields.description: Original grade recorded on the linked Lot, retained for reference.

fields.label: Tested Grade
fields.description: Grade identified by the tester after evaluating the tea sample.

fields.label: Dry Leaf Appearance
fields.description: Observations about dry tea leaf size, colour, shape, tips, and overall appearance.

fields.label: Infusion (Wet Leaf)
fields.description: Observations about the infused wet leaf, including colour, evenness, brightness, and leaf condition.

fields.label: Liquor
fields.description: Observations about brewed tea liquor, including colour, brightness, clarity, and strength.

fields.label: Taste and Flavour
fields.description: Assessment of briskness, body, aroma, flavour, astringency, and aftertaste.

fields.label: Defects / Quality Issues
fields.description: Specific quality issues observed during testing, such as stale, smoky, coarse, musty, or other undesirable characteristics.

fields.label: Quality Score
fields.description: Overall quality score based on the tea testing team's established scoring criteria.

fields.label: Testing Remarks
fields.description: Additional observations, defects, quality concerns, or recommendations.

fields.label: Tested By
fields.description: User responsible for performing the tea sample testing.

fields.label: Workflow State
fields.description: Current state of the tea testing process, managed by the workflow.
